edits.headline: Florida school bus crash kills two including a 10th grader
edits.subheadline: The bus overturned in a head-on crash in Winter Haven, in Polk County, ABC News 4 reported.
editorialBody: Two people, including a 10th-grade student, were killed when a school bus overturned in a head-on crash in Winter Haven, Florida, ABC News 4 reported. Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd said a preliminary review of video showed the bus was in its lane when an oncoming car drifted over the centre line.
Tennessee failed to execute Christa Pike on 30 September, and Governor Bill Lee halted executions in the state for the rest of the year, Fox 4 News reported.
India's Supreme Court agreed to examine a plea to recall its split verdict on the law governing appointment of the chief election commissioner, ThePrint reported.
